SUPPORT

How can we help?

Speech Recognition Cloud is a Windows voice dictation application that uses cloud-based AI to transcribe your voice to text. The transcribed text is automatically typed at your cursor in any Windows application.

Speech Recognition Cloud also has the ability to enhance transcriptions with AI through its AI Modes feature.

Install, set up your microphone, and start dictating in minutes.

How to use Speech Recognition Cloud

Speech Recognition Cloud works in any text field in any Windows application. Word, Outlook, Chrome, EMRs, web forms, messaging apps, or anything else where you can type.

1

Place your cursor in a text field where you want the text to appear

2

Press your hotkey (CapsLock by default) to start recording

3

Speak what you want to type

4

Press the hotkey again to stop recording and transcribe

5

Optional - Professional and Medical: set up the mobile companion app to dictate from your phone. See mobile setup guide →

The hotkey can be customised in Settings. Popular alternatives include F1-F12, tilde (~), Scroll Lock, or Pause.

Quick tips

Re-paste hotkey

Press Ctrl+Alt+V to paste the last dictated text. Useful if you forgot to place your cursor in the right field before dictating.

Double-tap to send Enter

Double-tap your hotkey to stop recording and automatically add an Enter keystroke after the transcription. Useful for sending messages in chat apps without touching your keyboard. Can be enabled in Settings.

Minimise to system tray

Click the minimise button to hide Speech Recognition Cloud to the system tray. You can also enable "Start minimised" in Settings to have it start hidden automatically.

Custom vocabulary

Add names, technical terms, and context to your vocabulary in Settings. This helps the transcription engine recognise specialised words.
